items.title: Holiday Shoppers Are Forecast to Put $21.3 Billion on Buy Now, Pay Later
items.summary: Equity Insider News Commentary - Buy now, pay later has become a fixture of holiday checkout, and one of the largest names in the category reports quarterly results before the bell today. Adobe forecasts that U.S. consumers will spend a record $21.3 billion through buy now, pay later during the 2026 holiday season, up 6.6% year over year, as part of a record $275.1 billion in total online spending between November 1 and December 31. items.title: Coda and Visa partner to deliver seamless and trusted gaming commerce across Southeast Asia
items.summary: Coda, a global leader in digital content monetisation and distribution, today announced a five-year partnership with Visa, a global leader in digital payments, to support the growth of gaming commerce across Southeast Asia.
